items.claim: Q3 2026: No quarterly report as a public company yet; the newest figures are in the final prospectus (Form 424B4, filed 19 November 2026). Q3 2026 revenue was $16,956m (Q2 2026: $11,555m; Q3 2025: $1,382m), about +47% quarter-on-quarter and roughly 12x year-on-year; nine-month 2026 revenue about $33.2 billion, reported by Fox Business as up 1,206% year-on-year. GAAP operating result swung from +$974m in Q2 2026 to -$567m in Q3 2026, attributed mainly to $5.0 billion of short-term compute purchases and $2.0 billion of non-cash donation-matching charges. Adjusted operating income was $2.5 billion in Q3 vs $2.2 billion in Q2, with adjusted operating margin falling from 19% to 15%; nine-month adjusted operating income $4.1 billion vs an adjusted loss of $3.1 billion a year earlier. Net loss was $23,291m in Q3 2026 (about $104 billion for nine months), driven overwhelmingly by fair-value changes on convertible notes, derivatives and SAFEs rather than operations. Fox Business cites $6.6 billion of positive nine-month operating cash flow. TTM revenue was $35.3 billion to 30 September 2026.

Q3 2026 / 9M 2026 (ended 30 September 2026): FY2025 annual figures badly understate the current scale: quarterly revenue went from $2,040m in Q4 2025 to $16,956m in Q3 2026, and the GAAP operating result was a $567m loss in Q3 2026 after a $974m profit in Q2, so annual figures alone miss both the revenue jump and the margin swings from compute purchases.
South Korea privacy regulator opens a formal investigation into a security incident that may have exposed personal information tied to more than 100 corporate Claude accounts
Illinois BIPA class action (Ortiz Colon) alleges undisclosed retention of facial-geometry data from identity verification; transferred from California state court to federal court
US FTC confirms an investigation of Anthropic, OpenAI and other AI companies under Section 5 (unfair or deceptive practices); no complaint, order or finding

Pentagon (Department of War) supply-chain-risk designation: N.D. Cal. (Judge Lin) ruled it illegal retaliation on 27 August 2026, but a 2-1 D.C. Circuit panel upheld the separate designation on 25 September 2026; Ninth Circuit case ongoing
Reddit v. Anthropic (San Francisco Superior Court): Judge Kahn largely denied Anthropic's motion to dismiss the contract and unfair-competition scraping claims
Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell sue Anthropic in US federal court in California alleging pirated lyrics and sheet music were used to train Claude
Bartz v. Anthropic (N.D. Cal.) authors' copyright class action: $1.5 billion settlement over storing pirated books receives final approval; appeals of the approval pending
Pascual v. Anthropic (N.D. Cal., No. 4:26-cv-07699) consumer class action alleges backend changes made Pro and Max subscribers exhaust usage limits faster (UCL, CLRA, False Advertising Law)
Kahn v. Anthropic (N.D. Cal., No. 3:26-cv-05763) consumer class action alleges Max 5x and Max 20x plans deliver materially less usage than advertised
New opt-out authors' suit in California federal court after Bartz alleges direct and contributory copyright infringement and removal of copyright management information
Concord, Universal Music and ABKCO sue Anthropic, Dario Amodei and Benjamin Mann (N.D. Cal.) alleging BitTorrent downloads of books containing their compositions from LibGen and Pirate Library Mirror
Concord Music Group v. Anthropic (N.D. Cal., original lyrics case): Judge Lee denied Anthropic's motion to dismiss the amended secondary-liability and DMCA claims
UK CMA merger inquiry into the Amazon/Anthropic partnership closed: the partnership does not qualify for investigation under the Enterprise Act 2002
